caption: The drawing depicts a light-colored, short-sleeved dress or gown, likely made for a child, rendered primarily in soft shades of cream and beige with some faint gray and brown shadows for depth. The dress features a gathered neckline with a drawstring tie at the front, which forms a small bow. Both sleeves are puffed and finish with delicate lace trim. The main body of the dress is slightly flared and is adorned with subtle vertical creases and folds, giving the fabric a textured appearance. There are a few small orange-brown stains or spots distributed on the front section of the dress. The lower edge of the dress includes two rows of simple decorative bands above a wide ruffled hem. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, and the entire composition centers the dress prominently on the page. The artist’s signature is in cursive near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Baby Dress
